instrument_changed: From a per-subject SIGNIFICANCE RATE (fraction beating their own permutation null at p<0.05) to a RELIABILITY COEFFICIENT. E28's 20% floor was a BCI-illiteracy PREVALENCE applied to a DETECTION RATE at n=45, which is rule 30; the floor is NOT lowered and E28 stands as ABSENT. Reliability is the quantity that decides whether a noisy label can be a regression target at all, and it bounds every future experiment on this deposit rather than one candidate. Reads no candidate feature.
outcome_detail: LABEL VIABLE. G1 passed at 0.9283 across 104 subjects (median |diff| 0.0348) with the corrected 9-draw estimator against the unchanged 0.90 floor. P1: r_half +0.1709, r_sb +0.2918 [+0.1163,+0.4345] over 200/200 splits, 105 subjects - the interval excludes zero, so the label IS a usable per-subject target. CEILING = sqrt(r_sb) = 0.5402. P2: executed movement r_sb +0.3034 [+0.1334,+0.4347], indistinguishable from imagery. NEITHER registered branch fired: it is not that imagery is specifically weak, and not that 45 trials supports nothing. Both arms carry the same modest reliability, so the deposit supports per-subject labels and the limit is precision. P3 placebo: permuted-label r_sb +0.0218 [-0.1061,+0.1387] vs real +0.2918. PASSED. THE PAYOFF - E28 becomes runnable and sizeable. Blankertz 2010 (PMID 20303409, verified via E-utilities) reports r=0.53 at N=80; their label reliability is at most 1, so the true correlation is >=0.53 and the observable correlation here is >= 0.53 x 0.5402 = 0.286. At n=104 the Fisher-z SE is 0.0995: r=0.286 is 2.96 SE (p=0.0031, detectable), r=0.181 (pessimistic end of the reliability CI) is 1.84 SE (p=0.066, NOT detectable). Minimum detectable r at 80% power = 0.272, so the cohort is adequately powered for an incumbent-strength predictor WITH ALMOST NO MARGIN; n=239 if reliability sits at the low end. CAVEATS: Blankertz label is BBCI feedback over a full session, not a 45-trial offline decode; our incumbent is a declared weaker proxy and should sit BELOW 0.286; and 0.286 is a lower bound. P4 DEFECT, reported: caps of 15 and 22 trials per class per half are unreachable (subjects have a median of 22 per class TOTAL, so 11 per half is the maximum), so those two arms repeat the cap-11 data and differ only by RNG. The curve has two real points, not four, and its non-monotonicity is that repetition. Rule 40 family - arms that cannot vary - and checkable from the trial counts before the run. SCOPE: no sentence here is about disorders of consciousness.

primary: r_sb = Spearman-Brown-corrected split-half reliability of per-subject imagery decoding AUC over 200 random stratified splits, subject-level bootstrap CI. Descriptive, not pass/fail: if the CI includes 0 the label carries no reliable between-subject variance and E28's design is unrunnable on this deposit. ceiling = sqrt(r_sb) bounds any feature-label correlation by attenuation.
question: How much of E28's per-subject BCI label is real? Split-half reliability of motor-imagery decoding accuracy, and the attenuation ceiling it imposes on any resting-state predictor.

NOT a family comparison: one phase feature only, stated in the header.
outcome_detail: NO EVIDENCE either way - the outcome registered in advance as most likely. Supports NEITHER explanation and in particular does NOT vindicate E36 post-hoc defence (rule 31). G1/G2 both passed in both cohorts: ds004541 7 of 8 subjects evaluable, best EMG legibility 0.148 and best state legibility 0.325 against a 0.10 floor; chennu 20 of 20, 0.175 and 0.400. So there was a real artefact contrast and a real state contrast to compare against. P1 ds004541 Contrast +0.0113 [-0.1750,+0.1966]. P2 chennu +0.0417 [-0.1935,+0.2674]. P4 correctly NOT INFORMATIVE (rule 48 fired as designed). BOTH POINT ESTIMATES LEAN TOWARD THE DEFLATIONARY EXPLANATION AND THAT IS NOT EVIDENCE: two estimates of +0.011 and +0.042 with intervals near +/-0.2 agreeing in sign are two coin flips landing the same way. The agreement check exists to WITHHOLD a claim on disagreement, not to manufacture one on a match. WORTH MORE THAN THE PRIMARY: wpli_alpha sits mid-pack on artefact legibility in both cohorts (EMG legibility 0.045 in ds004541, 0.100 in chennu, against spreads of 0.006-0.148 and 0.050-0.175 across six amplitude and complexity measures). The STRONG version of the deflationary story - wPLI barely responds to artefact - is not what these tables look like, in either cohort, with our own implementation. E35/E36 status UNCHANGED: still unclaimed, the deflationary explanation remains live and untested at adequate power. Kallionpaa 2020 / Akeju 2014 remain the strongest support for the underlying observation and are independent of this question. WHY IT COULD NOT DELIVER, for the next attempt: one phase feature (a single measure cannot average down its own noise); 8 and 20 subjects; and chennu ships 4 rows per subject so its EMG split is 2-vs-2 and its state contrast 1-vs-1. Nested cumulative horizons become disjoint bands; the position check becomes a per-band gate; the statistic becomes the raw out-of-fold AUC rather than a folded one. No candidate is compared against any other, so this cannot rescue E34 or E37 -- it can only say whether there was anything further out for them to have found.
outcome_detail: NOT INTERPRETABLE. All eight bands refused by their own gates - seven on position (position-AUC 0.026-0.060, i.e. 0.44-0.47 from chance against a 0.20 ceiling), one on coverage. No band statistic computed, no candidate ever scored. The gate fired exactly where the registration said it would. FEASIBILITY PROBE RUN BEFORE REGISTERING ANY SUCCESSOR shows no successor can be built: controls are 26,489 no-loss-after windows at median position 0.90 against 819 far-from-loss windows, while band windows sit at median position 0.26-0.35. Within-recording position-matched controls: 1,045 of 14,220 at [0,30) s, 60 of 3,369 at [180,240) s, and 0 of 2,131 at [300,420) s from 0 recordings. THE CONFOUND IS STRUCTURAL: in DOSE-I "far from a loss" means "after the last loss", because procedural sedation cases end awake, so there is no population of early-in-record windows far from any loss. The information-horizon question CANNOT BE ASKED on this deposit by any design. Q10 item 2 closes as checked-and-impossible, like Q9 item 2. RULE 37 COMMITTED BY THIS FILE, THIRD OCCURRENCE IN THE PROJECT: the band verdict was one-sided (excludes_chance = lo > 0.5), so the placebo printed "at chance" for every band while SEF95 scored 0.237 [0.115, 0.418] under a FAKE landmark - an interval entirely BELOW chance, i.e. discriminable. Corrected to two-sided, the placebo is discriminable in 5 of 7 gated bands and the curve is NOT flat. So the design had TWO independent fatal flaws and the one-sided operator hid the second; had the position gate passed, this file would have reported a horizon while printing "placebo flat: True" beneath it. Verdict code deserves the same scrutiny as analysis code. Challenge C is unchanged: three reportable verdicts stand, and whether the ceiling is the transition own sharpness remains OPEN and unanswerable here.
placebo: P3: identical banding around a fake landmark drawn uniformly in the middle 70% of each recording. The placebo curve must be FLAT AT CHANCE in every gated band; if a fake landmark produces a horizon the banding itself manufactures discrimination and the primary is void. Reported NOT INFORMATIVE if the incumbent's nearest band already includes 0.5 (rule 48).
primary: THE INFORMATION HORIZON: the smallest disjoint band edge at which the INCUMBENT's out-of-fold AUC interval includes 0.5. A property of the LABEL, not of any measure -- no candidate is scored against any other. Bands are DISJOINT because E37's nested horizons cannot measure a lead time.
question: How far ahead is loss of consciousness visible AT ALL, to anything including the monitor proxy? Separates 'no information earlier' from 'no information the incumbent lacks' -- QUEUE.md Q10 item 2.
